name: Eldritch Master
description: Spend 1 minute asking your patron for aid to get back every spent Pact Magic slot.
Then it is locked until your next long rest.

name: Fey Presence
uses: Once per short or long rest
description: A wave of fey charm and menace spreads from you in a 10 ft cube. Each creature inside makes a Wisdom save against your warlock spell save DC.
Those who fail are charmed by you or frightened of you (you choose which), lasting to the end of your next turn.
Recharges on a short or long rest.

name: Misty Escape
trigger: You take damage
uses: Once per short or long rest
description: Taking damage lets you dissolve into mist. As a reaction, become invisible and teleport to a free space in sight as far as 60 ft away.
Invisibility holds until your next turn begins, unless you attack or cast a spell first. Recharges on a short or long rest.

name: Beguiling Defenses
trigger: A creature tries to charm you
description: Charm cannot affect you. When a creature attempts it anyway, spend your reaction to reflect the effect back. That creature rolls a Wisdom save against your warlock spell save DC, and on a failure you have it charmed for 1 minute, or sooner if it is hurt.

name: Dark Delirium
uses: Once per short or long rest
description: Choose a creature within 60 ft that you can see. It makes a Wisdom save against your warlock spell save DC. If it fails, you decide whether it is charmed or frightened. This lasts 1 minute, but stops if your concentration breaks or the target takes damage.
The target thinks it is lost in a mist-filled realm you design, and perceives only itself, you and that illusion.
Recharges on a short or long rest.

name: Dark One's Blessing
trigger: A hostile creature drops to 0 hit points from you
description: Each time a hostile creature falls to 0 hit points by your hand, you receive temporary hit points: your Charisma modifier plus your warlock level, with a minimum of 1.

name: Dark One's Own Luck
trigger: You roll for an ability check or a save
uses: Once per short or long rest
description: After seeing the roll of an ability check or saving throw you make, but before its effect lands, add a d10 to it.
Recharges on a short or long rest.

name: Hurl Through Hell
trigger: You hit a creature with an attack
description: When you hit with an attack, send the target through the lower planes. It vanishes and comes back at the end of your next turn, in its old space or the nearest open one.
A target that isn't a fiend takes 10d10 psychic damage from the ordeal.
Recharges on a long rest.

name: Entropic Ward
trigger: You are the target of an attack roll
uses: Once per short or long rest
description: Spend your reaction to give the incoming attack roll disadvantage. Should it miss anyway, you have advantage on your next attack roll against that attacker, as long as you make it before your next turn ends.
Recharges on a short or long rest.

name: Create Thrall
description: Touch a humanoid that is incapacitated. It stays charmed by you until someone casts remove curse on it, the charm is lifted another way, or you use this feature again.
While you both share a plane, you can speak to the thrall mind to mind.

name: Agonizing Blast
description: Eldritch blast deals extra damage equal to your Charisma modifier on each beam that hits, so it grows with the extra beams you gain later.

name: Armor of Shadows
description: Cast mage armor on yourself whenever you like. It uses no spell slot and needs no material components. Recast it when it runs out.

name: Ascendant Step
description: Cast levitate on yourself at will, with no spell slot and no material components. Rise above enemies, traps and gaps whenever you need to.

name: Beast Speech
description: Cast speak with animals as often as you like. It never costs a spell slot, so you can chat with any beast you meet.

name: Beguiling Influence
description: You gain proficiency in Deception and in Persuasion. Nothing to activate; it is a permanent bonus whenever you roll those skills.

name: Bewitching Whispers
description: Once per long rest, spend a warlock spell slot to cast compulsion.

name: Book of Ancient Secrets
description: Pick two 1st-level spells with the ritual tag, from any class list, and write them in your Book of Shadows. They do not count as spells known, and you cast them only as rituals with the book in hand. Warlock spells you already know that carry the tag can be cast as rituals too.
You can copy more rituals you find into the book if the spell level is no more than half your warlock level, rounded up. Each spell level takes 2 hours and 50 gp of ink.

name: Chains of Carceri
uses: At will, once per creature per long rest
description: Cast hold monster at will, with no slot or material components, but only against a celestial, fiend or elemental. After you use it on a creature, you must finish a long rest before targeting that same creature again.

name: Devil's Sight
description: You see normally in darkness, magical or not, out to 120 feet. Always on, with nothing to activate.

name: Dreadful Word
description: Cast confusion once by spending a warlock spell slot. Wait for a long rest before doing it again.

name: Eldritch Sight
description: Cast detect magic at will, without spending a spell slot. Use it as often as you like, including as a ritual.

name: Eldritch Spear
description: Your eldritch blast reaches out to 300 feet instead of its normal range, so you can strike from far outside enemy reach.

name: Eyes of the Rune Keeper
description: You can read any writing, in any language or script. It is always on, so there is nothing to activate.

name: Fiendish Vigor
description: Cast false life on yourself at will, always as a 1st-level spell. It needs no spell slot and no material components, so you can refresh your temporary hit points after every fight.

name: Gaze of Two Minds
description: Touch a willing humanoid. Until the end of your next turn you perceive through its senses, including any special senses it has, while you are blind and deaf to your own surroundings.
Spend your action on later turns to keep the link going another turn. It works only while you share a plane of existence with the creature.

name: Lifedrinker
description: Every pact weapon hit adds necrotic damage equal to your Charisma modifier; the bonus is never below 1.

name: Mask of Many Faces
description: Cast disguise self at will, with no spell slot spent. Change your look as often as you like.

name: Master of Myriad Forms
description: Cast alter self at will, with no spell slot spent. Reshape your own body as often as you like.

name: Minions of Chaos
description: Cast conjure elemental once by spending a warlock spell slot. Take a long rest before using this again.

name: Mire the Mind
description: Cast slow once by spending a warlock spell slot. You regain this use after a long rest.

name: Misty Visions
description: Cast silent image at will. It uses no spell slot and no material components, so you can conjure illusions as often as you like.

name: One with Shadows
description: While you stand in dim light or darkness, use your action to turn invisible. You stay invisible until you move, take an action or take a reaction.

name: Otherworldly Leap
description: Cast jump on yourself at will, with no spell slot and no material components. Use it whenever you need to clear a gap.

name: Repelling Blast
description: When eldritch blast hits a creature, you may shove it up to 10 feet directly away from you.

name: Sculptor of Flesh
description: Cast polymorph once by spending a warlock spell slot. You cannot do so again until a long rest.

name: Sign of Ill Omen
description: Cast bestow curse once by spending a warlock spell slot. Finish a long rest to use it again.

name: Thief of Five Fates
description: Cast bane once by spending a warlock spell slot. It is available again after a long rest.

name: Thirsting Blade
description: When you take the Attack action, you can attack twice with your pact weapon instead of once.

name: Visions of Distant Realms
description: Cast arcane eye at will, with no spell slot spent. Scout around corners and through walls as often as you like.

name: Voice of the Chain Master
description: You can talk to your familiar telepathically and see and hear through it, as long as you share a plane.
While perceiving through it, you can also speak with your own voice through the familiar, even if it normally cannot talk.

name: Whispers of the Grave
description: Cast speak with dead at will, with no spell slot spent. Question a corpse as often as the situation allows.

name: Witch Sight
description: You see the true form of shapechangers and of creatures hidden by illusion or transmutation magic, as long as they are within 30 feet and in your line of sight.

name: Aspect of the Moon
description: Sleep is optional for you, and no magic or other means can make you fall asleep. A long rest still takes 8 hours, but you can spend all of it on light activity, like reading your Book of Shadows or standing watch.

name: Cloak of Flies
uses: Once per short or long rest
description: Wrap yourself in a magical aura of buzzing flies that reaches 5 ft around you, stopped only by total cover. It ends if you are incapacitated or when you dismiss it with a bonus action.

While it lasts, Charisma (Intimidation) checks get advantage and all your other Charisma checks get disadvantage. Any other creature starting its turn inside the aura suffers poison damage of your Charisma modifier (min 0).

name: Eldritch Smite
trigger: Your pact weapon hits a creature
description: Spend a warlock spell slot to add 1d8 force damage, plus 1d8 more for each level of the slot. If the target is Huge or smaller, you can also knock it prone.

name: Ghostly Gaze
uses: Once per short or long rest
description: For 1 minute you see through solid objects out to 30 ft, and you have darkvision in that range if you lack it. Objects appear to you as ghostly, see-through images. Like a spell, it needs your concentration and ends early if that breaks.

name: Gift of the Depths
uses: Once per long rest, no slot

spells.uses: Once per long rest, no slot

description: You can breathe water, and your swimming speed equals your walking speed.
Once per long rest you can also cast water breathing without spending a spell slot.

name: Gift of the Ever-Living Ones
description: While your familiar is no more than 100 ft from you, any dice you roll to regain hit points count as their highest possible result.

name: Grasp of Hadar
trigger: Your eldritch blast hits a creature
uses: Once on each of your turns
description: Drag that creature 10 ft closer to you in a straight line.

name: Improved Pact Weapon
description: Weapons you summon with Pact of the Blade can serve as your spellcasting focus for warlock spells.
The weapon gains +1 to hit and damage, except a magic weapon already carrying a bonus to those rolls.
Your conjured weapon can also be a longbow, shortbow, heavy crossbow or light crossbow.

name: Lance of Lethargy
trigger: Your eldritch blast hits a creature
uses: Once on each of your turns
description: That creature loses 10 ft of speed until your next turn ends.

name: Maddening Hex

prereq.text: Hex spell, or a cursing warlock feature

description: Stir up a psychic disturbance around the creature under your curse, from hex or a cursing warlock feature (Hexblade's Curse, Sign of Ill Omen and the like). You must see it, and it must be within 30 ft.
It and any creatures you choose within 5 ft of it that you can see take psychic damage equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1).

name: Relentless Hex

prereq.text: Hex spell, or a cursing warlock feature

description: Your curse ties you to its target. Teleport by magic to a spot within 5 ft of the creature under your curse (from hex or a cursing warlock feature like Hexblade's Curse or Sign of Ill Omen). The spot must be unoccupied, visible to you and no more than 30 ft away, and you must see the cursed target.

name: Shroud of Shadow
description: Cast invisibility whenever you want, without spending a spell slot.

name: Tomb of Levistus
trigger: You take damage
uses: Once per short or long rest
description: Encase yourself in ice, which melts when your next turn ends. Your warlock level times 10 becomes temporary hit points, which absorb the triggering damage first, as far as they go.
Once that damage lands, you are vulnerable to fire, your speed is 0 and you are incapacitated. When the ice melts, all of this ends, along with any temporary hit points left.

name: Trickster's Escape
uses: Once per long rest, no slot

spells.uses: Once per long rest, no slot, on yourself only

description: Once per long rest, cast freedom of movement on yourself without spending a spell slot.

name: Pact of the Chain
description: You learn find familiar, which does not count against your spells known, and can cast it as a ritual. You may pick an imp, pseudodragon, quasit or sprite as its form, as well as the usual ones.
When you take the Attack action, you can skip one of your attacks so your familiar makes one attack of its own.

name: Pact of the Blade
description: Use your action to conjure a melee pact weapon in your empty hand, in any form you like. You are proficient with it and it counts as magical against resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks.
It vanishes if it is more than 5 feet from you for 1 minute, if you dismiss it (no action) or summon it again, or if you die. An hour-long ritual can bind a magic weapon as your pact weapon.

name: Pact of the Tome
description: Your patron hands you a Book of Shadows. Take three cantrips of any class. Carrying the book lets you cast them freely, and they do not eat into your cantrips known.
If the book is lost, a 1-hour ceremony during a rest gets you a new one.

name: Hexblade's Curse
uses: Once per short or long rest
description: Bonus action: curse a creature in sight no more than 30 ft away, for 1 minute. It ends early if the target dies, or if you die or are incapacitated.

While it lasts, your damage rolls against the target gain a bonus equal to your proficiency bonus, and your attack rolls against it score a critical hit on a 19 or 20. If it dies, you heal by your warlock level + your Charisma modifier (at least 1 hit point).

name: Accursed Specter
trigger: You slay a humanoid
description: You can make the slain humanoid's spirit rise from its corpse as a specter bound to you. Uses the specter stats (Monster Manual).

It arrives with half your warlock level in temporary hit points, rolls its own initiative and takes its own turns. It follows your spoken commands, and adds your Charisma modifier (minimum +0) to its attack rolls.
It stays with you until your next long rest is over, then departs for the afterlife.

name: Armor of Hexes
trigger: An attack roll from your Hexblade's Curse target hits you
description: Roll a d6: a 4, 5 or 6 turns the hit into a miss, whatever it rolled.

name: Master of Hexes
trigger: Your Hexblade's Curse target dies
description: Shift the curse onto another creature within 30 ft that you can see, as long as you aren't incapacitated. Doing so means no healing from the first target's death.

name: Bonus Cantrips
description: You learn light and sacred flame. Both are warlock cantrips for you, and neither takes up one of your cantrips known.

name: Healing Light
resource: d6s from your Healing Light pool
description: You have a pool of d6s: 1 + your warlock level dice. All spent dice come back when you finish a long rest.

Bonus action: pick a creature in sight no more than 60 ft away to heal. Spend dice from the pool, no more than your Charisma modifier at a time (at least 1), roll them, and the creature regains hit points equal to the total.

name: Radiant Soul
trigger: Your spell deals radiant or fire damage
description: You resist radiant damage.
When a spell you cast deals radiant or fire damage, choose one of its targets: one radiant or fire damage roll against it gains a bonus equal to your Charisma modifier.

name: Celestial Resilience
trigger: A short or long rest of yours ends
description: You gain warlock level + Charisma modifier in temporary hit points.
As the rest ends, choose up to five creatures in sight: each gains half your warlock level + your Charisma modifier as temporary hit points.

name: Searing Vengeance
trigger: Your turn starts and you need to roll a death saving throw
description: Skip the save: you heal by half your hit point maximum and may stand up.
Radiant energy bursts out: creatures you choose within 30 ft each take 2d8 + your Charisma modifier radiant damage and are blinded until this turn ends.

name: Additional Warlock Spells
description: Adds Tasha's extra spells to the Warlock list, so you can learn them as warlock spells.
They carry an Optional tag wherever they show.

name: Pact of the Talisman
trigger: Whoever wears your talisman fails an ability check
uses: Proficiency bonus times per long rest
description: Your patron gives you an amulet. Its wearer, you or anyone you hand it to, adds a d4 to the failed check and may succeed after all.
If you lose it, a 1-hour ceremony during a short or long rest brings a new one from your patron and destroys the old. It turns to ash when you die.

name: Bond of the Talisman
uses: Proficiency bonus times per long rest, one pool shared by you and the wearer
description: While another creature wears your talisman and shares your plane, teleport to the free space nearest to it.
The wearer can also spend its action to teleport to you in the same way. Your teleports and theirs draw on the same uses.

name: Eldritch Mind
description: Your Constitution saves to keep concentrating on a spell are rolled with advantage.

name: Far Scribe

spells.uses: At will, no slot, only to a creature named on the page

description: Cast sending, with no slot and no material components, to any creature named on a special page of your Book of Shadows. You write the message on the page, and any reply appears there instead of in your head. The writing fades after 1 minute.
The page holds as many names as your proficiency bonus. A creature signs it with its action, if you allow it. Action: touch the page to erase a name.

name: Gift of the Protectors
trigger: A creature named on the page drops to 0 hit points without being killed outright
uses: Once per long rest, for the whole page
description: It is left at 1 hit point instead. After that, no one on the page can be saved this way until you finish a long rest.
The page is a new one in your Book of Shadows and holds as many names as your proficiency bonus. A creature signs it with its action, if you allow it. Action: touch the page to erase a name.

name: Investment of the Chain Master
description: Bonus action: order your familiar to take the Attack action.
Reaction, when your familiar takes damage: it resists that damage.

Each time you cast find familiar, the familiar also gets a 40 ft flying or swimming speed (you pick), its weapon attacks count as magical against resistance and immunity, and saves it forces use your spell save DC.

name: Protection of the Talisman
trigger: Whoever wears your talisman fails a saving throw
uses: Proficiency bonus times per long rest
description: The wearer adds a d4 to that save and may succeed after all.

name: Rebuke of the Talisman
trigger: An attacker you can see, no more than 30 ft from you, hits whoever wears your talisman
description: Psychic damage equal to your proficiency bonus hits the attacker, which is also pushed as far as 10 ft from the wearer.

name: Undying Servitude
uses: Once per long rest, no slot

spells.uses: Once per long rest, no slot

description: Once per long rest, cast animate dead without spending a spell slot.

name: Tentacle of the Deeps
description: Summon a 10-ft spectral tentacle up to 60 ft away at a point in view, for 1 minute or until you summon a new one. It makes a melee spell attack (yours) against a creature no more than 10 ft from it.
On a hit: 1d8 cold damage (2d8 from level 10), and the target's speed is 10 ft lower until your next turn begins.
On later turns, move it and attack again with a bonus action (Tentacle of the Deeps (Move)).

name: Tentacle of the Deeps (Move)
description: Shift your tentacle up to 30 ft and make its melee spell attack again, with the same damage and slow.
Doesn't spend a use of Tentacle of the Deeps.

name: Guardian Coil
trigger: Damage is dealt to you or a visible creature within 10 ft of your tentacle
description: Have the tentacle shield that creature: cut the damage it takes by 1d8 (2d8 from level 10).

name: Grasping Tentacles
uses: Once per long rest without a spell slot

spells.uses: Once per long rest without a spell slot

description: Cast Evard's black tentacles. You always know it as a warlock spell, outside your spells known, and once per long rest you can cast it without a spell slot.
Every casting also gives you temporary hit points, one per warlock level, and damage can't break your concentration on it.

name: Fathomless Plunge
uses: Once per short or long rest
description: Teleport yourself and up to five willing creatures you can see within 30 ft. You all reappear as far as 1 mile away, in or within 30 ft of a body of water you've seen that is pond-sized or larger, each landing in an empty space no more than 30 ft from the rest.

name: Genie's Wrath
trigger: You hit with an attack roll
uses: Once on each of your turns
description: Add damage equal to your proficiency bonus to the target. Its type depends on your genie kind: Dao bludgeoning, Djinni thunder, Efreeti fire, Marid cold.
Works while you are touching your Genie's Vessel.

name: Bottled Respite
description: Vanish into your Genie's Vessel, which you must be touching; the vessel stays where you were. You can stay up to twice your proficiency bonus in hours.
Inside: a cylinder 20 ft high with a 20-ft radius, styled like the vessel, with cushions, low tables and a comfortable temperature. You hear the area around the vessel as if you stood there.

You come out into the nearest empty space when you leave (Bottled Respite (Leave)), die, or the vessel is destroyed. Objects left inside stay until carried out; if the vessel is destroyed they appear in the nearest empty spaces.

Level 10 (Sanctuary Vessel): bring up to five willing creatures you can see within 30 ft in with you. Anyone who stays inside 10 minutes or more gets the benefit of a short rest, and adds your proficiency bonus to hit points regained from Hit Dice spent there.
The vessel: a Tiny object and focus for your warlock spells. AC equals your spell save DC; hit points equal your warlock level + proficiency bonus; immune to poison and psychic damage.

name: Bottled Respite (Leave)
description: Leave your vessel early, appearing in the nearest empty space to it.
Level 10 (Sanctuary Vessel): you can instead eject any number of creatures from it. Everyone inside comes out if you leave or die, or the vessel is destroyed.

name: Elemental Gift
description: Gain a 30 ft flying speed for 10 minutes, and you can hover.
Always on: resistance to one damage type set by your genie kind: Dao bludgeoning, Djinni thunder, Efreeti fire, Marid cold.

name: Limited Wish
description: Ask your patron, speaking to your Genie's Vessel, for the effect of one spell of 6th level or lower with a casting time of 1 action. It can come from any class's list.
You ignore the spell's requirements, costly components included; the effect simply happens as part of this action.
Afterwards you must finish 1d4 long rests before you can use it again.

name: Dao
description: Your patron is a noble dao, a genie of earth.
Its spells join your warlock list: sanctuary (1st), spike growth (2nd), meld into stone (3rd), stone shape (4th), wall of stone (5th).
Genie's Wrath deals bludgeoning damage, and Elemental Gift (level 6) gives resistance to bludgeoning.

name: Djinni
description: Your patron is a noble djinni, a genie of air.
Its spells join your warlock list: thunderwave (1st), gust of wind (2nd), wind wall (3rd), greater invisibility (4th), seeming (5th).
Genie's Wrath deals thunder damage, and Elemental Gift (level 6) gives resistance to thunder.

name: Efreeti
description: Your patron is a noble efreeti, a genie of fire.
Its spells join your warlock list: burning hands (1st), scorching ray (2nd), fireball (3rd), fire shield (4th), flame strike (5th).
Genie's Wrath deals fire damage, and Elemental Gift (level 6) gives resistance to fire.

name: Marid
description: Your patron is a noble marid, a genie of water.
Its spells join your warlock list: fog cloud (1st), blur (2nd), sleet storm (3rd), control water (4th), cone of cold (5th).
Genie's Wrath deals cold damage, and Elemental Gift (level 6) gives resistance to cold.
